description: Source code implementing FIS table updating functions for MTD devices in OpenWrt, including functions for opening, validating, and remapping FIS tables.

methods.name: fis_close
methods.description: Closes the FIS descriptor and unmaps memory.

methods.name: fis_open
methods.description: Opens and maps the FIS table from the device.

methods.name: fis_validate
methods.description: Validates the FIS table against old and new partition info.

methods.name: fis_remap
methods.description: Remaps the FIS table with new partition info.
